name: music_effects_drawer
description: Sound check: verify audio effects work via Music Drawer .method() syntax
script: announce 1/6: Baseline — no effects, drawer pianoroll
strudel edit "c4 e4 g4 c5".pianoroll() cps=0.5
strudel edit "c4 e4 g4 c5".lpf(400).pianoroll() cps=0.5
strudel edit "c4 ~ e4 ~ g4 ~ c5 ~".room(0.7).pianoroll() cps=0.4
announce 6/6: Multi-line — bass with filter, melody dry
strudel edit bass: "c2 g2 c2 e2".lpf(400).pianoroll() | melody: "c4 e4 g4 c5".pianoroll() cps=0.4
notify {SCRIPT} "Did .lpf/.room/.delay produce audible changes from drawer?" ["All good","Issues","Broken"] {inspect} blocking
